description: Take a .png of one open surface, page or targetId in a live session (Safari: pages only); open it with extension_open first.

browser.description: Session browser; required when several run.

context.description: page: the tab url picks; else that open surface.

path.description: A .png or folder/ under projectPath or an MCP root.

projectPath.description: Project root of a running session: extension_dev, extension_start, or `npx extension dev|start` by hand

store.description: Store listing size, for extension_submit sync-listing.

targetId.description: A page's targetId (extension_open, or dom_snapshot listTargets); overrides url.

name: extension_screenshot
